history.name: Statistics_Expert
history.content:
Before finalizing, I recommend a dataset-wide consistency check and a quick distribution assessment to ensure our steam identification is robust. The "Type/Wheel Configuration" field varies, so let's standardize detection and evaluate steam prevalence across all operational locomotives. Also, a simple normality check on counts can guide if proportions are stable day-to-day. I'll compute global operational steam ratio and a Shapiro-Wilk test on wheel-config frequency counts. Python code:
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import shapiro
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/4d0aa727-86b1-406b-9b33-f870dd14a4a5.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
df = df.dropna(subset=['Operating Status'])
df['Operating Status'] = df['Operating Status'].str.strip().str.lower()
df['Excursion/Location'] = df['Excursion/Location'].astype(str).str.strip()
df['Type/Wheel Configuration'] = df['Type/Wheel Configuration'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
# Operational across the museum
op = df[df['Operating Status'] == 'operational']
steam_wheels = ['0-4-0','2-6-0','4-4-0','2-8-0','2-10-0','2-8-2','4-6-2','2-6-2','2-10-2','4-6-0','4-8-4']
op['is_steam'] = op['Type/Wheel Configuration'].apply(lambda x: ('steam' in x) or any(w in x for w in steam_wheels))
num_total_op = len(op)
num_steam_op = int(op['is_steam'].sum())
ratio = num_steam_op / num_total_op if num_total_op else 0
# Frequency counts by wheel config
wc_counts = op['Type/Wheel Configuration'].value_counts()
# Shapiro-Wilk on counts (only if enough distinct categories)
vals = wc_counts.values
if len(vals) >= 3:
    W, p = shapiro(vals)
    print("Global operational total:", num_total_op)
    print("Global steam operational:", num_steam_op)
    print("Global steam ratio:", round(ratio, 3))
    print("Shapiro-Wilk W:", round(W, 3), "p:", round(p, 3))
else:
    print("Global operational total:", num_total_op)
    print("Global steam operational:", num_steam_op)
    print("Global steam ratio:", round(ratio, 3))
    print("Shapiro-Wilk not applicable; too few categories")
# Given fairness across excursions, a stable global ratio can inform odds when excursion assignments vary day-to-day.
